NMTS Start the Week Rite Ride (4th Monday)

Albuquerque, NM · Road · Social

Beginner friendly

NMTS Start the Week Rite Ride (4th Monday) is a road and social group ride in Albuquerque, NM. It rolls fourth Monday of the month at 9:00 am from NE corner of San Pedro and Candelaria. About 20 miles, 13 mph (plus or minus 1), minor hills.

Next ride Mon, Oct 26, 9:00 AM MDT

For visitors

Helmets are required on all NMTS rides. E-bikes are welcome at the ride leader's discretion. The club points newer riders to this ride.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NMTS Start the Week Rite Ride (4th Monday) group ride

A monthly easy-pace ride of about 20 miles on bike trails and bike lanes, led by Tom Sullivan. It began as a birthday ride for the club treasurer in 2013. The club calls it a good beginner ride.
